plan:
Create a School Management System (SMS) that satisfies the acceptance criteria. The system will be implemented in Python using a modular structure. A main application file (school_management.py) will coordinate between Student, Grade, and Schedule models, and provide an interface (CLI or webhook/API-ready) for administrators and teachers to perform CRUD operations and generate reports. Since the repository currently has no existing SMS files (all existing files are unrelated), we must create the necessary files. To keep the plan within the limit of 5 files (including the main model and report generator), we will consolidate the system into a single main application file: school_management.py. This file will contain the data structures for students, grades, schedules, report generation logic, and a simple CLI menu for interaction. No test modifications are required; existing tests in test.py will continue to pass as the new file introduces no dependencies that would conflict with existing modules.
